english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something characterized by narcissism or excessive preoccupation with the self.
Use this when “vain” focuses on excessive admiration of one's own looks or self-image.

examples.english: They are always taking selfies in front of the mirror; they’re really narcissistic.
examples.traditional: 佢成日對住塊鏡影自拍，真係好自戀。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 faai3 geng3 jing2 zi6 paak3 zan1 hai6 hou2 zi6 lyun2

examples.english: They are very vain and admire themselves in the mirror every day.
examples.traditional: 佢好自戀，日日對住個鏡欣賞自己。
